newsitem.title: USA: Laboratory Corp CEO Powell leaves.
newsitem.headline: Laboratory Corp CEO Powell leaves.

text.p: Laboratory Corp of America Holdings said on Monday its president and chief executive officer James Powell planned to leave the company to become the CEO of AutoCyte Inc.
He would continue to serve on LabCorp's board and as a consultant to the company, LabCorp said.
The company said it would name a successor on Tuesday.

It said the change was not linked with the company's recent settlement with the U.S. government. LabCorp said at the beginning of December its chief operating officer resigned following the settlement of a federal investigation into prior billing practices of LabCorp's predecessor companies.

AutoCyte is a new cancer diagnostic company in which Powell is a principal investor, it said. The company was spun-off by Hoffmann-La Roche, and is focused on the development of advanced automated pap-smear technology.
